intent: Freeze the upstream SPINC DS2712 switch-mode charger power stage for golden JLC Rev A. This file documents equivalence constraints only; do not treat it as a redesign specification.

control_stage.description: U8/DS2712 CC1 enables the current-control loop through Q4. When enabled, U8/CSOUT hysteretically controls the Q5 switching-PMOS gate through Q4. R37 pulls the Q5 gate back to 5 V (off); R36 biases Q4 gate-to-source.

buck_stage.description: 5 V feeds Q5, the main P-channel switching MOSFET. Its drain is the switch node shared with the D2 catch diode and L1 input. L1 feeds the output node; D4 provides series isolation into the H-bridge/high battery rail. D3 clamps the L1 output node toward 5 V for positive transients.

catch_diode.note: KiCad D_SMA pad 1 is K and pad 2 is A; this is the freewheel/catch diode from GND to the switch node.

output_series_diode.note: KiCad D_SMA pad 1 is K and pad 2 is A; current flows from the L1 output node toward the battery/H-bridge high rail.

pads.role: package NC; must stay explicit NC

safety_invariants: Q5, not Q4, remains the main 5 V switching PMOS.
U8.CC1 must remain connected to Q4 gate and U8.CSOUT to Q4 drain.
Q4 source, Q5 gate, R36.2 and R37.2 must remain one shared gate-control node.
R37 must continue pulling the Q5 gate-control node to 5 V so the switching PMOS defaults off.
D2 remains the catch diode from GND to the Q5/L1 switch node.
L1 remains 47 uH in golden Rev A; do not substitute merely for sourcing optimization.
D4 remains in series between the L1 output node and the H-bridge/VP1 high rail.
D3 pin 2 remains explicitly NC and its clamp orientation must not be reversed during JLC library remapping.
The DS2712 current-sense return remains the separate R34/R35 low-rail path frozen in critical-charger-audit.json.
Rev A layout migration must preserve a compact high-di/dt loop around Q5, D2 and L1 and preserve Kelvin-quality R34/R35 sensing.
